title: Is Mall World really just a large airport or train station instead?
content: Hear me out. Most airports and train stations are basically elaborate malls turned into labyrinths. I feel as though there is far too much urgency, chaos, and foot traffic for these to be just malls. Points of transport are not quite here nor there… you’re suspended in the middle. When my dad was in hospital he kept asking about traveling to Rome and if I had made hotel reservations. He died a few months later and I remember researching this phenomenon at that time and finding that many describe dreams of traveling just before the end. https://www.bethcavenaugh.com/blog/travel-metaphors-at-the-end-of-life https://i.stuff.co.nz/life-style/10539263/The-dying-often-know-they-re-going-to-go Perhaps this is why so many ancient cultures, like the Egyptians, prepare the dead to embark on a journey. Maybe we are all visiting an airport or train station too. There’s very little difference between most travel hubs and true malls in the modern world.
